evidence_tiers.primary: Three-seed evidence used to support a main empirical claim.
evidence_tiers.supporting: Three-seed ablation or sensitivity evidence that qualifies a main claim.
evidence_tiers.diagnostic: Post-hoc dynamical analysis with a narrower protocol than the main battery.
evidence_tiers.exploratory: Control evidence that is reported for scope but is not a main positive claim.

main_manifold_metrics.csv.scope: Eight manifold-memory tasks crossed with CA-LRU and five recurrent or state-space baselines, aggregated over seeds 0, 1, and 2.
limitations: Task-specific epsilon values were selected from the stored sweep without a separate held-out validation split.
RMSE is ambient output-component RMSE, not intrinsic manifold-coordinate error.
Normal-kick recovery RMSE combines autonomous retention drift with recovery from the perturbation.

update_ablation_metrics.csv.scope: State-dependent, input-only, and linear update rules on the four integration tasks, each using the task-selected epsilon and seeds 0, 1, and 2.
limitations: This table isolates the update rule but does not isolate every historical implementation detail outside the compared final-block variants.
The same post-hoc task-specific epsilon-selection limitation as the main table applies.

ring_integrate_ood_metrics.csv.scope: Temporal, velocity, single-kick, and repeated-kick out-of-distribution evaluation for ring integration across CA-LRU, its linear-update control, and five baselines.
limitations: The protocol covers ring integration only and should not be generalized to every manifold task.
Final and post-hold endpoints measure different stages and must not be mixed in one numerical comparison.
Recovery endpoints include both perturbation recovery and blank-input retention drift.

epsilon_sensitivity.csv.scope: CA-LRU sensitivity to epsilon in {0, 3e-5, 1e-4} for all eight manifold-memory tasks and seeds 0, 1, and 2.
limitations: The sweep is evaluated on the same task family used to choose the paper-facing epsilon values.
It is a discrete three-value sweep rather than a continuous robustness analysis.

rp_control_metrics.csv.scope: Retention Plasticity controls comprising historical no-RP and all-slow linear-scaffold runs plus aligned, fixed-permutation, and freshly shuffled RP-score controls on the final state-dependent scaffold.
limitations: The no-RP and all-slow controls use the historical linear-update PAN-full scaffold, not the final state-dependent CA-LRU scaffold.
The fixed-permutation control is not a count-matched control.
The final-scaffold alignment controls cover ring hold, ring integration, and torus integration rather than all eight tasks.

retention_scaling_metrics.csv.scope: Line-integration scaling at intrinsic dimensions 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 for CA-LRU with epsilon 1e-4 and seeds 0, 1, and 2.
limitations: Scaling is measured on line integration only.
The maximum tested intrinsic dimension is 16 with a 96-coordinate recurrent carrier.
PCA participation ratio is an empirical geometric diagnostic, not an exact intrinsic-dimension estimator.

ring_transport_seed_values.csv.scope: Per-seed ring on-manifold transport diagnostics for five model or update variants after 2,000 blank steps.
limitations: The probe uses one base angle and a finite 1,440-point clean-state grid.
Distances are measured in the stored full diagnostic state rather than solely in the recurrent carrier.
This is a ring-specific post-hoc diagnostic rather than the full eight-task evaluation battery.

ring_transport_summary.csv.scope: Three-seed mean and sample standard deviation of the ring on-manifold transport diagnostics.
limitations: It summarizes the same narrow single-base-angle protocol as ring_transport_seed_values.csv.
The finite-grid and full-diagnostic-state distance limitations remain unchanged after aggregation.

discrete_control_metrics.csv.scope: K-way point-memory and four-bit flip-flop controls for four baselines and two CA-LRU epsilon settings over seeds 0, 1, and 2.
limitations: The discrete-task runs are quick controls rather than the central continuous-manifold benchmark.
CA-LRU flip-flop performance is seed-unstable, so this table does not support a claim of uniformly solving discrete memory.
The table contains task-specific metric columns; cells for metrics belonging to the other discrete task are intentionally empty.
